settings.heading: Where is my serial number?
settings.text: The Serial number is located in two places. The first place is the back bottom right of the firebox Or on the shipping box next to the model label.

settings.heading: Can I get my grill assembled?
settings.text: MG Products require assembly. We provide videos on how to assembly on our website along with digital manuals. You can check with your local retailer that carry Monument Grills for 3rd party assembly services.

settings.heading: Do accessories and grill arrive together if I buy a bundle order?
settings.text: The grill and accessories will be sent in separate packages and might not arrive at the same time.

settings.heading: I received the wrong item! What do I do?
settings.text: Mistakes happen and we apologize! Contact us via Email (CustomerService@Monumentgrills.com) or Chat and we will create a return for the incorrect item. Once that item has been successfully dropped off or picked up by the carrier your replacement No charge order will be created and a new Order number with tracking information will be emailed to you.

settings.heading: How to install my Denali grill?
settings.text:
We include a user manual in the package of each product with detailed assembly instructions. You can also watch our assembly video. 

The link: https://monumentgrills.com/pages/assembly-manuals-and-videos

settings.heading: Why is Denali's warming rack constructed differently than regular ones?
settings.text: Denali's warming rack is a multifunctional design capable of holding chicken thighs, chicken legs, roast peppers, and much more, offering greater versatility compared to ordinary cooking grids.

settings.heading: Where can I see the temperature?
settings.text: You can check the temperature via Bluetooth app or Smart Temperature Display.

settings.heading: Is the Bluetooth stable to use?
settings.text: Yes, the Bluetooth connection with the grill is reliable for up to 65 feet outside.
